fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects a suspicious child process spawning from Outlook where the image is located in a remote location (SMB/WebDav shares).
fields.name: Suspicious Remote Child Process From Outlook
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (src.process.image.path contains "\\outlook.exe" and tgt.process.image.path contains "\\\\"))
